status: Historical definitions reconciled; 2027 difference remains unallocated rather than an identified forecast miss. Frozen forecasts unchanged.
main_conclusion: The selected model is an economic owner-cash forecast. Public vendor FCF and Intel adjusted FCF use different boundaries. Historical differences are verified. A negative 2027 public FCF forecast was already present, and the model-minus-consensus headline cannot be treated as an overlooked cash shortfall without matching financing capital payments, lease cash, capital-credit receipts, SBC and minority treatment.

exact_number_corrections.not_supported_by_primary: 14.649 investing, 3.057 financing, and 17.706 gross were preliminary approximations and must not be used.

FY2025_reconciliations.classification_fact: Intel states that capital-vendor payment terms longer than 90 days are reported as financing activities when paid. The FY2025 unpaid extended-term balances were approximately 1.5B, which is not a 2027 payment schedule.

TTM_construction: Full FY2025 + first nine months FY2026 - first nine months FY2025. This reproduces S&P/SWS CFO17.472 and FCF3.768 exactly. Do not compare nine-month totals directly to annual forecasts.

model_2027_bridge_B.warning: Neither backsolve is asserted as a GAAP CFO forecast. Future cash-credit versus tax-offset classification, lease principal/interest allocation, inventory/depreciation timing and tax normalization are not fully reconstructed.

conditional_algebra.definitions: E = the model gross-PPE cash amount that would be classified as financing rather than investing; X = portion of the selected 3B capital-credit collection realized in CFO rather than separate investing cash; L = portion of the 1B all-in lease/supplier allowance outside CFO. These variables are not estimated here.
conditional_algebra.comparison_at_L1: With all 1B lease cash outside CFO, vendor-like FCF is -9.992712883085713 + X + E. Matching -4.159 would require X+E=5.833712883085713.
conditional_algebra.interpretation: Historical financing-PPE cash of3.026B in FY2025 and2.151B TTM shows that billion-dollar definition differences are real. It does not prove either illustrative 2027 E amount, nor that all remaining disagreement is classification. Do not select E or X to force consensus agreement.

capital_credit_boundary.primary_policy: Intel recognizes capital-related grants and refundable credits as reductions to PP&E and reduces depreciation over asset life. It reports capital-related government proceeds in investing cash flows; it also says some credits may settle tax payments due.
capital_credit_boundary.classification_status: The precise future split of the model-selected old tax-receivable collections between cash grants/refunds and offsets against tax payments has not been established. The model labels the receipt as economic cash, not an audited CFO line.

presentation_decision.admit: Public forecasts already anticipate negative 2027 FCF. Our model tests economic cash retained for common owners after more explicit claims and capital funding; it has not established an undiscovered cash-flow miss against a fully matched consensus.
reject: Calling owner cash -11.69B directly comparable to public FCF -4.159B.
Calling 24.507B an exact issuer CFO forecast without incentive/lease reconciliation.
Calling the 27.723B residual a verified capex forecast or assuming a future extended-payment amount.
Presenting negative cash conversion alone as new information unavailable to analysts.
